tldr: 台股週二重挫 2,030.83 點、跌幅 4.65%，終場收 41,603.36 點，寫下史上第三大收盤跌點，全球晶片股崩跌、中國 DUV 曝光機自製傳聞與韓股熔斷式暴跌重擊市場信心。
台積電跌 70 元至 2,280 元（跌 2.98%），失守約 2,347 元的季線，半導體 AI 族群評價全面下修，市場情緒由貪婪轉為恐懼。
政策面，金管會最快 7 月底公布 7 家銀行內部評等法（IRB）准駁、有助釋放資本，並同步推動跨業聯防機制以抑制散戶槓桿風險。

items.title_zh: 台股崩跌 2,030 點，寫史上第三大跌點
items.title_en: TAIEX plunges 2,030 points in third-worst point drop ever
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週二終場收 41,603.36 點，重挫 2,030.83 點、跌幅 4.65%，為史上最大單日跌點之一，成交量爆增至約 1.23 兆元。電子權值股遭全面調節，反映美股與亞股晶片股隔夜崩跌。專家點出 40,000～42,000 點為短線支撐，並示警 AI 評價疑慮與槓桿去化恐使盤面續呈高波動，投資人宜控管風險、留意季線與外資動向。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index collapsed 2,030.83 points, or 4.65%, on Tuesday to finish at 41,603.36, one of the steepest single-day point losses in its history. Turnover swelled to about NT$1.23tn as electronic heavyweights were dumped en masse, tracking an overnight rout in US and Asian chip stocks. Analysts flagged 40,000–42,000 as near-term support, warning that AI-valuation jitters and forced deleveraging could keep the tape volatile in coming sessions.

items.title_zh: 台積電摜破季線，台達電盤中一度跌停
items.title_en: TSMC breaks below quarterly line as Delta hits limit-down intraday
items.summary_zh: 權值王台積電收 2,280 元、下跌 70 元、跌幅 2.98%，跌破約 2,347 元的季線，為入春以來首見。賣壓擴散至全盤，台達電盤中一度摜至跌停 10% 後收斂，記憶體股華邦電、南亞科同步重挫。指標性技術支撐失守，凸顯 AI 樂觀情緒迅速轉為法人防禦性操作，短線多空易位、盤面結構轉弱，宜審慎因應。
items.summary_en: Market leader TSMC dropped NT$70 to close at NT$2,280, down 2.98%, slipping under its quarterly moving average around 2,347 for the first time since the spring. Losses spread across the index: Delta Electronics briefly tumbled to its 10% limit-down before paring, and memory names Winbond and Nanya fell sharply. The break of key technical support underscored how quickly AI-driven optimism has flipped to defensive positioning among institutions.

items.title_zh: 中國 DUV 曝光機自製傳聞，撼動全球晶片供應鏈
items.title_en: China DUV-tool self-sufficiency rumors rattle global chip supply chain
items.summary_zh: 市場傳出中國已具備深紫外光（DUV）曝光機國產自製能力，衝擊半導體類股，市場憂心成熟製程恐面臨供給過剩與價格壓力。美股晶片股走跌，費城半導體指數下跌逾 4%、美光挫約 9%，台積電 ADR 亦跌約 2%。對以晶圓代工為核心的台灣供應鏈而言，此傳聞在 AI 評價已高之際，再添地緣政治與競爭面的不確定變數，後續量產進度與良率仍待觀察。
items.summary_en: Reports that China has achieved domestic production capability for deep-ultraviolet (DUV) lithography equipment sent shockwaves through the semiconductor sector, stoking fears of an eventual supply glut and pricing pressure in mature nodes. US chip stocks slid, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down more than 4% and Micron off around 9%, while TSMC's ADR fell about 2%. For Taiwan's foundry-centric supply chain, the news adds a fresh geopolitical and competitive overhang atop already-stretched AI valuations.

items.title_zh: AI 資本支出疑慮升溫，市場情緒由貪婪轉恐懼
items.title_en: AI-capex doubts flip market mood from greed to fear
items.summary_zh: 分析師指出，本波半導體賣壓反映市場對 AI 資本支出可持續性的疑慮加深，並非單一利空，投資人如今傾向將所有消息負面解讀。電子權值股首當其衝評價下修，台積電季線攻防被視為大盤關鍵技術戰場。此番情緒轉折出現在 AI 領漲數月之後，後市恐由指數方向轉為個股輪動與精選操作，波動加大之際更須留意資金流向與基本面分歧。
items.summary_en: Strategists said the semiconductor sell-off reflects deepening scepticism over the sustainability of AI capital spending rather than a single catalyst, with investors now reading every headline negatively. Electronic heavyweights bore the brunt of the de-rating, and the defense of TSMC's quarterly line was cited as the key technical battleground for the broader market. The shift marks a sentiment inflection after months of AI-led gains, raising the odds of continued rotation and stock-picking over index-level direction.

items.title_zh: 金管會最快 7 月底核定 7 家銀行採內部評等法
items.title_en: FSC to clear seven banks for internal-ratings-based approach by end-July
items.summary_zh: 金管會對 7 家銀行申請採用信用風險內部評等法（IRB）的審查已進入尾聲，最快 7 月底公布結果，過關銀行 8 月起即可採用。申請者包含 6 家系統性重要銀行（中信、國泰世華、台北富邦、合庫、兆豐、第一銀）加上玉山銀。獲准後可降低風險性資產、減輕資本計提壓力，並釋放放款與配息空間，對相關金控資本效率與股東回報具正面挹注，為近期金融股少數利多。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission's review of seven banks' applications to adopt the credit-risk internal-ratings-based (IRB) approach is in its final stage, with results due as early as end-July and approved banks able to use the method from August. Applicants include six domestic systemically important banks — CTBC, Cathay United, Taipei Fubon, TCB, Mega and First — plus E.Sun. Approval would lower risk-weighted assets, easing capital requirements and creating room for expanded lending and dividends.

items.title_zh: 金管會推跨業聯防機制，抑制散戶槓桿風險
items.title_en: FSC pushes cross-industry joint-defense to curb retail leverage
items.summary_zh: 面對散戶以信貸買股增加，金管會銀行局表示多重貸款戶比例僅個位數、銀行逾放比維持 0.14%～0.16%，整體風險可控。為防範過度槓桿，主管機關加速推動銀行與券商間的「跨業聯防機制」，未來將雙向交換信用資訊。截至 6 月底，小額信貸餘額 8,096 億元、年增 12.12%，增幅居各類個人貸款之冠，顯示消費信用擴張須審慎控管，聯防機制上路後有助強化風險監理與資訊透明。
items.summary_en: With retail investors increasingly using personal loans to buy stocks, the FSC's banking bureau said multiple-loan borrowers remain in the single-digit percentages and banks' non-performing-loan ratio is steady at 0.14%–0.16%, keeping overall risk contained. To pre-empt excessive leverage, regulators are accelerating a cross-industry "joint-defense mechanism" enabling two-way credit-information exchange between banks and brokerages. Small-ticket personal loans grew 12.12% year-on-year to NT$809.6bn, the fastest among consumer-loan categories.

items.title_zh: 富豪財管規模逼近 2.7 兆元，高階客戶年增逾 7 成
items.title_en: High-net-worth wealth pool nears NT$2.7tn as elite clients jump over 70%
items.summary_zh: 台灣高資產「財管 2.0」架構下的管理資產規模已攀升至近 2.7 兆元，頂級客戶數年增逾 7 成，國銀競逐快速擴張的高資產客群。該制度放寬合格銀行對資產達 1 億元以上客戶提供更多元商品與諮詢服務，吸引愈來愈多銀行與保險業者投入，在股市波動加劇之際，財富管理business已成金融機構的策略性獲利引擎，惟高資產客戶風險屬性與商品適配仍為經營重點。
items.summary_en: Assets under Taiwan's high-asset "Wealth Management 2.0" framework have climbed toward NT$2.7tn, with the number of top-tier clients growing more than 70% year-on-year, as banks race to capture a fast-expanding affluent market. The regime, which lets qualified banks offer a wider menu of products and advisory to clients with at least NT$100mn in assets, has drawn a growing roster of institutions and insurers, reinforcing wealth management as a strategic profit engine amid volatile equity markets.

items.title_zh: 半導體收益 ETF 00927 殖利率 18.01% 登頂
items.title_en: Semiconductor-income ETF 00927 tops yield rankings at 18.01%
items.summary_zh: 群益半導體收益 ETF（00927）以 18.01% 的年化殖利率登上 7 月配息排行榜首位，單季配息 1.88 元、創歷史新高，收益型商品持續吸引追求現金流的散戶資金。此現象凸顯主題式高配息 ETF 即便在股市重挫之際仍吸金，惟分析師提醒，帳面高殖利率可能受資本利得墊高、未必可持續，投資人應綜合評估總報酬與成分股體質，避免僅以殖利率為單一選擇依據，方能兼顧收益與風險。
items.summary_en: Capital Semiconductor Income ETF (00927) led July's high-yield rankings with an annualized yield of 18.01%, distributing NT$1.88 per unit for the quarter — a record high — as income-focused products draw yield-hungry retail demand. The surge underscores how thematic, high-distribution ETFs continue to gather assets even amid a sharp equity sell-off, though analysts caution that headline yields can be flattered by capital gains and may not be sustainable, urging investors to weigh total return and underlying holdings.
